node.statement: Exact unitality gives J bold-dot U=U bold-dot J=U and J^dagger=J. Since lem-stage1-polar-retraction states u_delta(A)=A for every A in calU, it follows that mu(J,U)=mu(U,J)=U and sigma(J)=J. Node 1.4 also gives ||mu(U,V)-U bold-dot V||<=84*epsilon_r and ||sigma(U)-U^dagger||<=84*epsilon_r.
